title: ForgeDiscord
description: The modded version of the popular Paper/Spigot plugin, DiscordSRV. This mod is not made by the developers of the plugin.
body: ![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1504248/description_b19f35ad-3f66-4671-ab3e-8afd31a7724c.png) This is the forge version of the popular Paper/Spigot plugin, DiscordSRV. **This mod was not made by the DiscordSRV developers** ![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1504248/description_d3c5015f-a1a5-47f8-a051-6a0070a9f9b4.png) This mod is made for `Forge 1.20.1`, with newer/older versions releasing soon, as well as soon to support other mod loaders like Fabric. To set this up, you will need to go to the Discord Developer Portal. Click `New Application`, set everything how you want the bot to look like (not going to go in depth of the full Discord bot stuff here, watch a tutorial on YouTube.), when everything is setup and the bot is invited to the discord server you want it in, go the the `Bot` tab, and you'll see a section called Token. ![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1504248/description_81c3486c-9dbc-4526-8c2e-f3d5118c110d.png) Click `Reset Token`, then a string of characters will be generated. Click copy token, then in your server files, go into the `config` folder, and look for `forgediscord-common.toml`. At the top of the file, there will be a line saying `token: "YOUR_TOKEN_HERE"`, paste in the token that Discord gave you, save the file, then restart the server. To see if the mod connected to the bot, you can type `/discord bot` in game, or you can look at the member list in the Discord server to see that the bot is online. ![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1504248/description_de3dd486-0484-423b-be13-f40d7cd38067.png) Want to download the plugin version? [Click Here](https://modrinth.com/plugin/discordsrv) Full credits to [Scarsz](https://modrinth.com/user/Scarsz), [granny](https://modrinth.com/user/granny), and [Vankka](https://modrinth.com/user/Vankka) to making the original plugin.
